note: Fast news feeds for the flash loop (tools/flash_loop.mjs, tools/flash_news.mjs). Each is one of tools/news_feeds.json's own feeds (the feeds thread owns which sources OSAP reads; this list only says which of them the loop also asks every minute or so): English, RSS, one country, and national wire, state agency, official or newspaper-of-record outlets in the countries OSAP's watches cover most. Chosen 2026-11-23 from the feeds that answered OSAP's own plain name (no browser-like client) from a cloud address; the ones that refused it (Yonhap English, The Straits Times, The Hindu, Hindustan Times, Punch, PIB) or timed out (IRNA) are left to the news lane. Each feed is asked at most once a minute (or less often when its own Cache-Control max-age says so, up to 5 minutes), with If-None-Match / If-Modified-Since, and backs off on 429 or 5xx.
